citations.review_text: Easy game to control with the keys. Bad news, it sometimes crashes.

with just about 50 mods you can get a really fun expierence of launching hunderds of cars to the moon and further while crossing the oceans and finnaly going to amerika by air.  also really reccomend getting a christmas tree in your cabin together with about 18 pets to keep you comfy, also dont forget to get a few train horns installed.

also why is there a random garage in hungary that just crashes the game when you try to buy it but if you glitch to it off the map it does just exist. 

aslo be warned of the stupid border control in the middel of the northsee, like why cant i just cross peacefully by truck WHY!?

i do defintivly reccomend getting a 70000hp engine for simulation purposes :)

also make sure to hang 20 things on your front window it will improve visibilty greatly.

overall amazing game to mess around in and its really stress relieving to launch evryone into the galaxy, 9/10

my only reason for not being a 10/10 is that there are sitll quiete a lot of barriers you cant get rid off with mods and also there is no electric trucks ;(

cohorts.summary: Long-term drivers highlight restricted base map options and localization bugs alongside heavy reliance on expansion packs.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that base game map content and country availability are limited without purchasing map expansion DLCs.

citations.review_text: This is one of the best simulator games i've ever played, been playing this since 2013. This is relaxing and really fun, lots of trucks to choose from (even the electric trucks, only available in quick jobs for now), for me the Map Expansion DLCs are mandatory as they're making the game more complete and the sceneries are awesome, one of the my best purchases in gaming.

I have played this game on and off for a few years now. For what it is it's quite well made. Yes it may be true that it doesn't have the best graphics but there are still areas of the game that are very beautiful. Mods can always improve this anyway although most likely with performance drop

For the people who play games like Forza or Beamng, do not expect any sort of damage model. While there is a damage system, there is no damage model which in a game like this I probably would have turned off anyways. 

This game has great modding support which is good considering the fact that customization in the base game is extremely limited. I personally run 16 mods (not saying you need anywhere near that many) and have multiple DLCs pertaining to customization due to this fact. 

My only other critique is that for being a game based in "Europe" it only features a few countries without the purchase of a DLC and even most of those few base game countries aren't entirely available without the purchase of a DLC and only have a few cities that you can visit. 

If you are looking to relax and just drive around the few countries provided and don't mind the lack of customization or size of the map, then you will definitely be happy with your purchase. If you do end up wanting more, then the DLCs for the map aren't too expensive and usually come with 1-2 whole countries. If you want customization, I recommend mods before DLCs since something like the mighty griffin customization DLC doesn't come with very many features compared to most mods. I'm not saying this game doesn't come with features or isn't fun to play without DLCs, I'm just saying it's a little disappointing how many of them are locked behind a pay wall.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe base game truck customization as extremely limited, noting that certain brands like Scania and DAF receive more focus while other truck brands lack options.

citations.review_text:
9/10. The graphics and physics are insane, the sound effects are crazy too. We have a lot of jobs options and truck customization is fine too. But to have a nice and pretty gameplay, get ready to spend some money on DLCs. One of the problems is that they seem to focus only on Scania and DAF when it comes to customization. Other truck brands dont have that much customizations and they will always look ugly, lol.

In my opinion the base game is kinda boring, i refuse to play it. i only play on TMP (TruckersMP) where there are over 3000 people in the same server. If youre like me and you don't enjoy playing with npcs that don't even interact with you, you might like TruckersMP. 

The game itself is not worth the money when it is not on sale, so i would recommend you to buy it during any sale. (the same with dlcs) 

You don't need to have a steering wheel to be able to enjoy the game, you can use your Controller, keyboard, mouse or a steering wheel. 

I would recommend this game for sure
